key_insight: Skill Adapter personalizes reusable agent skills and dynamically routes them as tasks, inputs, and environments change.
engineering_relevance: It offers a way to adapt shared agent procedures to user-specific tools and requirements while managing growing skill libraries.
method: Distill user requirements and execution feedback into Adapters linked to general-purpose skills.
Route applicable skills and Adapters into an online task library, preloading candidates and rechecking them when inputs become available.
Use reinforcement learning to optimize modification and routing decisions.
evidence_signal: On ALFWorld, WebShop, and SkillsBench, Skill Adapter improves task success by an average of 11.43 percentage points over SkillRL, reduces mean execution time on all three, and retains its performance advantage with 1,000 skills.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify training costs or adapter-maintenance overhead, which matter for deployment.
paper_title: Skill Adapter: Personalized Modification and Online Routing of General-Purpose Skills
